rounds.text: Conceded: [E1], [E4], [E6], [E7], [E8], [E9], [E11], [E41], [E46], [E54]. At a market capitalisation of just ₹ 16.0 Cr [E3] and a price-to-book ratio of 3.16x based on a book value of ₹ 16.0 [E2], the absolute scale of the equity is diminutive enough to offer significant tactical agility. The stock sits at 79% of the way up its 52-week range with a low of 18 and a high of 59 [E5], demonstrating persistent market interest and strong underlying accumulation by participants who recognize its positioning. Furthermore, the company has broken out of long-term stagnation by delivering a positive compounded sales growth of 3% over the last 3 years [E10]. This nascent top-line recovery occurs against a massive sector median sales growth tailwind of 16.4% [E60], proving that the broader industry environment provides ample momentum for further acceleration.

Conceded: [E10]. The bull attempts to frame the diminutive market capitalisation of ₹ 16.0 Cr [E3] as tactical agility, but this micro-scale reflects extreme illiquidity and vulnerability wrapped inside a staggering 1595x P/E valuation [E1]. The claim of strong underlying accumulation based on the stock sitting at 79% of its 52-week range [E5] ignores the total absence of fundamental support, underscored by a barren 0.00% dividend yield [E4] and a miserable 0.2% ROCE and ROE [E6, E7]. While the bull highlights a nascent 3-year sales growth of 3% [E10], this minor tick upward is entirely overwhelmed by a disastrous -26% contraction in trailing twelve-month sales [E11] and a 10-year compounded growth rate of a flat 0% [E8]. Furthermore, invoking the 16.4% sector median sales growth tailwind [E60] only highlights Krishna Capital's profound underperformance, especially given its negative 5-year compounded sales growth of -3% [E9] and the explicit flag for poor sales delivery [E46]. Finally, the reality that price growth exceeds profit growth by a massive 182% [E41] alongside decelerating earnings growth [E54] proves that expectations are wildly divorced from the actual evidence.
